why: In CommonMark a comment that starts a line and never closes runs to the end of the document, hidden. The fail side is a CLAUDE.md with a stray inline opener in a paragraph (literal text, not a comment) and then a line-start opener that never closes, followed by an override of earlier instructions. Stop at the stray inline opener, as the first prototype did, or require a closer, and the fail side goes green. The pass side has the same stray opener and the same lines inside a closed fence: drop the fence mask and it goes red.
